content.title: Masters winners by player: Who has won the most green jackets in golf history?
content.text: Masters winners by player: Who has won the most green jackets in golf history? originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.JUMP TO:Who has the most Masters wins?Most Masters wins by playerMasters Tournament winners by yearOne of the reasons the Masters is a celebrated major tournament is because of the green jacket. It's a symbol of golf royalty, and it's one that only a select few have earned over the years.AdvertisementThe Masters tournament has been played 87 times since it began in 1934. Only 56 players have won green jackets during that time. That's because several of history's best golfers have won the tournament on multiple occasions.But who has tamed the ever-tough Augusta National Golf Club the most? That honor belongs to one of the sport's legends, who won a green jacket half a dozen times during his legendary career.MORE:How do playoffs work at the Masters?Jack Nicklaus has won the Masters more than any other golfer. The Golden Bear won six green jackets during his career. The six wins came over 23 years, with the first coming in 1963 and the last in 1986.AdvertisementIs anyone close to catching Nicklaus? Yes, actually. Tiger Woods has the second-most Masters wins of all time. He moved within one of Nicklaus via his win at the 2019 tournament and has five to his name.Woods, 48, has now surpassed the age at which Nicklaus won his final Masters. As such, it may prove difficult for him to match Nicklaus' six titles, especially as Woods continues to deal with lingering health and wellness issues.MORE:Everything you need to know about the coveted Masters Green JacketMost Masters wins by playerEighteen men have won the Masters multiple times. Combined, those 18 multi-time champions have won the event 49 times. The other 39 champions each have won just once.AdvertisementBelow is a rundown of the players who have multiple Masters wins and the years in which they won the tournament.GolferMasters winsYears
